question: AB is a chord in the minor segment of a circle of centre Q. P is a point on the major arc AB. The tangents drawn from external point D to the circle are AD and BD. If ∠APB = 39°, then find the measure of ∠ADB.
solution:
**Given:**

∠APB = 39°

AD and BD are tangents from an external point D

**Concepts used:**

1. Angle at the center (∠AQB) = 2 × angle at the circumference (∠APB)

2. Angle between two tangents from an external point = 180° − angle at center

**Formula used:**

∠AQB = 2 × ∠APB

∠ADB = 180° − ∠AQB

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7c55c01df3f2232c52ed8aa684f787cbc581795c0893cfa1ed7f2b93e2fbd78.png] 

⇒ ∠AQB = 2 × 39° = 78°

⇒ ∠ADB = 180° − 78° = 102°

**∴ The measure of ∠ADB = 102°**
